lead: Bleak cinematic photograph, vast brutalist concrete interior, dust, dim brass light, verdigris.

images.name: structure
images.prompt: A city with no outside: stacked levels of concrete, pipes, walkways and shafts deeper than light reaches

images.name: outage
images.prompt: A dead control room, dark screens and cut cables, a disaster that switched everything off

images.name: room
images.prompt: Fragile walkways, stairs and chain-link nets over a dark drop, a lone hooded wanderer

images.name: trip
images.prompt: An old elevator platform arriving at a dark, abandoned station

images.name: reconnect
images.prompt: Rows of lights coming back on along a long corridor, people gathering in the glow

images.name: evening
images.prompt: A lone traveller resting on a bench in a quiet train carriage

images.name: collapse
images.prompt: Concrete platforms collapsing, debris raining down, dust after a huge blast

images.name: stranger
images.prompt: A ragged stranger sitting against a pillar, pointing the way down a corridor

images.name: nets
images.prompt: Chain-link climbing nets and ladders hanging over a blasted crater

images.name: hive
images.prompt: An organic insect hive growing over concrete walls and pipes
